calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_lines, min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(f.channel_code) c1, max(f.channel_code) c2
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, min(d.calendar_date) mn
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 8 AND 14
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.quantity) AS units_all, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, f.units_all, r.units_sold, f.receipts, r.receipts AS rpt_receipts
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=108
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND (f.units_all IS DISTINCT FROM r.units_sold OR f.units_all IS NULL OR r.units_sold IS NULL)
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS return_lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE cs.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
